title: Knights of Pythias — Audubon County Journal, June 29, 1911
goal: Extract people, places and a concise summary from an Inkstory clipping, reusing the supplied OCR.
source_ocr:
## KNIGHTS OF PYTHIAS

### Of Exira, Iowa, Were Entertained At The Audubon Lodge Wed day Night June 28th.

Tbe Knights of Pythias of Exira Lodge No. 181 were eutertained at the Audubon Lodge last oight. Giand Chancellor Dr. J. M. Cole delivered a very tine and helpful address after which Past Grand Chancellor B. I. Sallinger was called oa for a little talk and responded with an interesting speech.

The Lodge then resumed its duties and the Rank of Knighthood was conferred upon Mr. llenry I£ngle of Exira.

The evening ended with a fine two course luncheon prepared by the Audubon ladies and all partook to their stomach's content.

In tbe wee small hours of the night we bid farewell to tbe Audubon boys feeling that there was no tie that bound like "Pythian Love." We sure thank the Audubon boyB for the "Royal Good Time" they gave us aud extend a cordial invitation to all of them to cotne and visit with ua.
